# Urban365

> Urban365 is a Hebrew, right-to-left real-estate platform for Israel. Buyers and renters search listings for apartments and commercial property by city, neighbourhood, price, rooms and size. Licensed agencies publish and manage their listings through a CRM, and private sellers can publish their own property directly, without an agency.

Base address: https://urban365.co.il

## What a visitor can do

- Search for property for sale, for rent and commercial, filtered by city, neighbourhood, price, rooms and size. Search results are at /search.
- Browse city pages, one per city with listings: /nadlan/forsale/<city>, /nadlan/rent/<city>, /nadlan/commercial/<city>. The full list of cities is at /nadlan/cities.
- Open a single listing at /nadlan/property/<address-and-id>. Each listing shows its price, rooms, size, floor, amenities, photographs and the agency or seller behind it.
- Browse licensed real-estate agencies at /agencies, and each agency's public page at /agencies/<agency>.
- Save listings at /saved, and save a search to be alerted to new matches at /alerts.
- Estimate a property's value at /valuation, using comparable sales in the area.
- Work out a mortgage at /mortgage.

## Private sellers

A private seller can publish one property at /sell/new, without an agency and without a broker's commission. Listings they publish appear in their own list at /sell. Listings can be edited, taken off the market, or removed by the seller.

## Agencies

Agencies sign in at /agency/login and manage their listings, leads, customers, calendar and team from the CRM. Agency accounts are reviewed before they gain access.

## Key pages

- Home: /
- Search: /search
- Cities: /nadlan/cities
- Agencies directory: /agencies
- Valuation: /valuation
- Mortgage calculator: /mortgage
- Terms of use: /terms
- Privacy policy: /policy
- Accessibility statement: /accessibility
- Sitemap index: /sitemap.xml

## Pages that need an account

Saved listings, saved searches, the seller's own listings, the agency CRM and account settings require a signed-in account. A crawler is not given access to them and they are not in the sitemap.

## Usage

Scraping this site is not permitted. The listings, agency pages and city pages belong to Urban365 and to the people who published them. For AI training, use of the content is refused. Crawlers that copy pages in bulk may be rate-limited or blocked. Search engines may index the public pages listed in the sitemap. See /robots.txt.
